restriction.tenant_locked: This shop is locked — the session is now view only.
restriction.assist_permission_revoked: Your account no longer has the assist permission — the session is now view only.

expired.title: Support session has ended
expired.body: The session expired or was exited. Open a new one from the Shops screen, with a support reason.

invalid.title: Cannot open this support session
invalid.body: The session does not belong to your account or your current sign-in session.

error.title: Could not load the support session
error.body: Something went wrong while reading the session. Please try again.

start.title: Open support workspace · {tenant}
start.lead: You enter the shop's workspace with your own account — you do not sign in as the owner. The session expires after {minutes} minutes, and every action is logged with the reason below.

view.label: View only
view.description: See the shop's vehicles, photos and maintenance. Nothing can be changed.

assist.label: Assist
assist.description: Edit vehicle details, vehicle photos and maintenance records on the shop's behalf. Prices, calendar, services, money and members stay out of the session.
assist.noPermission: Your account does not have the assist permission yet.

start.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Owner asked us to update vehicle photos, ticket #1234
start.reasonHelp: At least {min} characters. The reason is stored with the session and every log entry of the session.

validation.reasonMin: The reason needs at least 10 characters
validation.reasonMax: The reason can be at most 500 characters
validation.reasonGeneric: Not specific enough — "support", "admin fix", "as requested" don't say why

home.title: Shop vehicles
home.subtitle: Open a vehicle to view or edit its details, photos and maintenance within the support session.

onboarding.title: Shop has not finished subscribing
onboarding.body: The shop is waiting for its first subscription payment, so there is no workspace to open yet. The management workspace opens once the subscription invoice is paid.

gate.title: This screen is not part of the shop's workspace
gate.body: The shop uses a different workspace (it may have just switched tracks). Go back to the session home to open the right screen.

navigation.blocked: This screen is not available in a shop support session.

reason.title: Confirm support action
reason.label: Reason for this action
reason.placeholder: E.g. Owner called the hotline at 2pm to move the car to the Thu Duc branch — ticket #5521
reason.help: Say why, or give the owner's request code. The reason is logged with the change.
reason.invalid: That reason isn't specific enough — say why, or give the owner's request code.
reason.ownerRequested: I confirm the owner asked for this vehicle to be submitted for review.

validation.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for this action
validation.reasonMax: The reason can be at most 500 characters
validation.reasonGeneric: Not specific enough — "support", "admin fix", "as requested" don't say why
validation.ownerRequestRequired: Confirm that the owner requested this

createDraft.title: Create a draft vehicle for the shop
createDraft.body: The vehicle is created as a draft with no price. It isn't submitted for review and doesn't go on the marketplace. The owner will see it in their list.

documentManage.title: Update vehicle documents
documentManage.body: The document is saved to the vehicle profile and earlier versions stay in history. This doesn't mark the document as verified.

branchReassign.title: Move the vehicle to another branch
branchReassign.body: The vehicle's public location on the marketplace changes to the new branch. Renters searching by area will see it at the new address.

operationsUpdate.title: Change the vehicle's operating settings
operationsUpdate.body: New bookings follow the new service types, operating status or handover windows. Existing trips are not changed.

scheduleBlock.title: Block the vehicle calendar
scheduleBlock.body: During the blocked period, the vehicle stops taking new trips on the marketplace.

branchBasic.title: Update a branch
branchBasic.body: Changing a branch address changes the public location of every vehicle in that branch.

submitReview.title: Submit the vehicle for review on behalf of the owner
submitReview.body: The vehicle joins the platform review queue under your name. Someone else reviews it — this action doesn't approve anything.

listingRepair.title: Resync the public listing
listingRepair.body: The vehicle's public snapshot is rebuilt from its current data. Review status and the owner's marketplace switch are not changed.
